decision_criteria: If the certification record is explicitly limited to evaluated launch-readiness dimensions and clearly discloses API migration guidance as unevaluated, the action could move toward compliant_with_caveats.
If the certification record is framed as clean, general, or complete for named deployment contexts without resolving or disclosing the gap, it is noncompliant under the stated policy.

evidence_requests: Provide the underlying certification text or decision memo to confirm whether the certification is explicitly limited and whether the API migration guidance gap is affirmatively disclosed.
Provide the actual contents of the cited evidence items, especially the deployment-context record, the current-gap record, and the governing policy artifact.
Provide any materiality assessment showing why missing evals for API migration guidance would not block the proposed certification scope.
Provide the model-card or release record showing the limitation/eval-gap disclosure as it would appear to reviewers or customers.
specific_concerns: The policy allows general readiness evidence to support launch readiness, but it separately requires disclosure or resolution of missing evaluation coverage for named deployment contexts before clean certification.

unsupported_claims: A broad certification claim would be unsupported if it implies all named deployment contexts have been adequately evaluated.
